# dulce-de-leche

> Rust CLI orchestrator for the charly-vibes tool ecosystem. One command (`ddl`) to install, configure, and update every tool, with per-tool health via `ddl status` and everything living under a clean `.ddl/` directory.
>
> File roles: this `llms.txt` is the machine index (link list + commands). `llm.txt` is the ecosystem-standard narrative summary (§3) covering ddl's role in the fleet standard. Content is kept in sync — edit both or neither.

## Authorship

All code in this repository was generated by a large language model. Human contribution: requirements, design decisions, planning, and review.

Leer en español: https://charly-vibes.github.io/charly-vibes/

## Commands

- `ddl init` — installs & configures the whole toolset
- `ddl status` — shows health of all tools at a glance
- `ddl migrate` — moves existing configs under `.ddl/`
- `ddl upgrade` — updates everything to latest compatible versions
- `ddl version` — full picture of installed tool versions

## Install

macOS & Linux via curl — stable bootstrap script; resolves the latest release,
downloads the archive AND its checksums.txt, and verifies the archive sha256
BEFORE extraction/execution (fail-closed: tampered or unverified archives are
never installed; mirrors the DDL-yts policy in src/installer.rs):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/charly-vibes/dulce-de-leche/main/install.sh | bash

# Pin a specific version instead of latest:
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/charly-vibes/dulce-de-leche/main/install.sh | DDL_VERSION=0.8.0 bash
```

Env overrides: `DDL_VERSION` (pin), `DDL_INSTALL_DIR` (default /usr/local/bin),
`DDL_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_RELEASE=1` (explicitly authorize installing when the
release publishes no usable checksum — same escape hatch as the Rust installer;
a checksum MISMATCH is never bypassed).

Then run it:

```bash
ddl init      # bootstrap the whole toolset
ddl status    # check ecosystem health
```

Also available: `brew tap charly-vibes/charly && brew install dulce-de-leche` (macOS/Linux), `scoop install dulce-de-leche` (Windows, charly bucket), or `cargo install dulce-de-leche`. Release assets: `ddl_<version>_{darwin,linux}_{amd64,arm64}.tar.gz` + `windows_amd64.zip` + `checksums.txt`, produced by the `release.yml` workflow on every `v*` tag.

## Managed tools

Core: `wai`, `testaruda` · Recommended: `turu`, `dont`, `ah` (espectacular) · Extension: `pretender`, `vampiro`, `incitaciones`, `bd`, `openspec`, `specodelic`.
